# Enterprise corpus

Config dumps and manifests recorded before Phase 4, on the enterprise distribution of kgateway. Scenario 06 was recorded on Gloo Gateway v1. They're kept as extra parser coverage (decision D-003): the dumps contain vendor filters that the OSS corpus doesn't.

The manifests and scripts are the originals and aren't kept in step with `hack/`.

This folder is removed before krp moves into kgateway (program edge E6). The OSS corpus in `testdata/scenarios/` is the main one.
